cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: the voice that frames each idea; never staged as a person
cast.look: Off-screen narrator voice; drawn only as a calm, neutral presence, never as a face.

cast.name: Cruz
cast.role: the overbooked professional whose 5:20 a.m. highway crash of focus opens the book's argument
cast.look: Cruz, a man in his late 30s, average build, short dark hair, wrinkled navy button-down shirt with the sleeves rolled up and a loosened tie, tired eyes with dark circles, holding a phone.

cast.name: Everyman professional
cast.role: a stand-in for any manager, freelancer, parent or student staring at a full to-do list
cast.look: A woman in her early 40s, average build, shoulder-length brown hair tied back, plain grey cardigan over a white blouse, a lanyard badge, holding a stack of papers.
